name: codex-comprehensive-orchestrator
description: A domain-agnostic Codex orchestration plugin with capability-aware model routing, bounded delegation, artifact workflows, research, computer operation, security triage, science, humanities, and verification.

interface.shortDescription: Route, execute, verify, and synthesize work across domains.
interface.longDescription: A domain-agnostic orchestration layer for Codex. It classifies goals, checks available tools and model capabilities, selects local skills or explicitly configured helper models, delegates bounded work, applies execution-time safety guidance, and returns one evidence-backed answer or artifact. It does not itself provide antivirus, browser control, unlimited model access, or a security authorization boundary.
defaultPrompt: Use this plugin to classify the task, check current capabilities, and choose the safest effective execution path.
Complete the requested code, document, presentation, spreadsheet, research, science, humanities, or computer task end to end with verification.
If a required modality or quality level is unavailable, use only explicitly configured helper models or ask me for the missing configuration; never invent a provider or expose secrets.
